slides.headline: The self-improving **business computer.**
slides.sub: Work closes its own loop. Memory, authority, receipts, outcomes. One standard for humans and agents.

slides.text: Work used to **end.** Now every action can become memory.
slides.sub: Stored work becomes acted work, then remembered work. Context, action, receipt, outcome, reward, better next action.

slides.heading: A business computer, not a chatbot

columns.b: Receipts compress into lessons and return as minimum useful context.
Humans and agents with owner, tools, authority, trail, and score.
Who authorized, who acted, what proof confirms it, what the business got.

slides.text: They learn the **click.** We learn the outcome.
slides.sub: Others reward the draft interaction. Atris rewards the business result: reply, booking, deal, recovery.

slides.heading: The market proved the gap.
slides.sub: Agents act everywhere. Almost none verify the result.

columns.b: Open tool harness. Periphery prepares work without usurping judgment.
Sends, money, and public acts pause for your approval with a judgment packet.
Deterministic block on AI UI tells, hype copy, and raw outbound artifacts.

slides.label: RL readiness lift after verified episodes
slides.sub: Diff, receipt, verifier, outcome. Atris runs on Atris.

slides.heading: Customer recovery first.
slides.sub: Close one painful loop. Prove the outcome. Expand.

slides.heading: Business model
slides.sub: We do not tax Members. Members close loops.

slides.tagline: Ambition and freedom should not cancel each other out.
